name: buddy
description: A pixel-art companion above your prompt: reacts to your session, grows up, unlocks accessories, watches your PRs, Slack mentions and meetings, and can post to a leaderboard with your friends

githubOrg.title: GitHub organization
githubOrg.description: Only your PRs in this GitHub org count for approval reactions. Leave empty for all of your PRs.

leaderboardUrl.title: Leaderboard page
leaderboardUrl.description: Optional: your leaderboard's link. /buddy leaderboard <link> sets it for you.

watchSlack.title: Watch Slack mentions
watchSlack.description: Alert when you're mentioned in Slack. Needs a Slack connector and an allow rule for its search tool.

watchCalendar.title: Watch calendar
watchCalendar.description: Alert when a meeting starts in the next 10 minutes. Needs a Google Calendar connector and an allow rule for its list-events tool.
